Subject: Travel compressed next week — demo timing?

Hi Ava,

Heads up: our leadership condensed onsite visits next week (Nov 10–12) so the original 90-min slot we discussed for the Redwood demo won't fit into the itinerary anymore. Two constraints: 1) several stakeholders will only be available in short 30–45 min pockets; 2) our lead engineer will be traveling between facilities and prefers async materials.

Would you be open to splitting the demo into a short executive-level 30-min walkthrough for decision makers + a separate technical deep-dive (40–60 min) for our engineering team later in the week or recorded? If you can also provide a short agenda and a recording option, that would help us align internally.

Appreciate the flexibility — let me know what times you can do.

Best,
Ellie Park
Director, R&D Ops
NovusMed

Thanks for the heads up, Ellie — totally understandable. We can absolutely pivot. Two options I propose:

1) Split sessions:
  - Day A (30 min): Executive walkthrough — high-level capabilities, latency/cost highlights, expected timelines for Dedicated/Private options. Attendees: PM/VP-level.
  - Day B (45 min): Technical deep-dive — architecture, quantization/throughput tradeoffs, and a short Q&A with an engineer (Connor).

2) Hybrid: 30-min live exec walkthrough + a recorded 45-min technical deep-dive that we can timebox to the 40–45 min window and share a recording and notes for your engineer to watch on their travel. We can also schedule a 20-min follow-up office-hours slot for live questions.

I attached a short agenda and a checklist for the recording (will capture the demo console and a short kernel selection slide). If either option works, tell me your preferred days/times and I will send calendar invites (I included tentative 30-min and 45-min slots for Nov 10–12 in the attached .ics).

We can also adapt the deeper engineering content into a short playbook (1–2 pages) summarizing batching/quantization recommendations for your workload. Connor will join the technical session.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
